definitions.explanation: A prefix or noun meaning a mix of various ingredients, most commonly used in cooking. Literally "five items," though the actual number of ingredients varies.

examples.japanese: {五目|ごもく}ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{昼|ひる}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五目|ごもく}そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had mixed noodles for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{五目|ごもく}{炊|た}き{込|こ}みごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧や⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My mother's mixed rice has chicken, carrots, and other ingredients in it.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "five items" ({五|ご}{目|もく}), though the actual number of ingredients in {五目|ごもく} dishes is not limited to five. The word simply means "assorted" or "mixed" in a culinary context.

COMPOUNDS:
- {五目|ごもく}ごはん / {五目|ごもく}⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧: mixed rice (with vegetables, meat, etc.)
- {五目|ごもく}そば: noodles with assorted toppings
- {五目|ごもく}{炊|た}き{込|こ}みごはん: mixed seasoned rice
- {五目|ごもく}⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧: simmered mixed beans
- {五目|ごもく}{寿司|ずし}: mixed sushi (chirashi-style)
